attributes.name: Sentinel Part
attributes.powers:
If defeated, draw this card. Then you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

While in hand, for your combat check, shuffle this card into your location deck to use your Strength skill + 2d10. If this is not your first combat check of the turn, add 2d12 instead. This counts as playing a weapon.

While in hand, when you defeat a barrier that has the Lock, Obstacle, or Trap trait, reveal this card to draw a weapon, an armor, or an item from your discard pile.
